mintAuthority.summary: USDU BSC issuance runs through UnitasMintingV2, whose 3-of-5 Safe admin can change rate limits and mint roles; the token's separate 3-of-5 owner Safe can replace that minter. Solana retains a non-null, self-referential Token-2022 mint authority; its signer custody is unresolved, so minting is not asserted to be disabled.

controls.label: USDU BSC owner — Gnosis Safe 3-of-5
controls.evidence: At BSC block 125056986, token owner() remained this 3-of-5 Safe and getOwners()/getThreshold() matched the recorded signers and threshold. getModulesPaginated returned no enabled modules and the canonical guard storage slot was zero. Verified USDu.sol gates mint() to its separate minter address, not onlyOwner; owner-only setMinter() lets this Safe replace that minter. Historical Safe implementation and fallback-handler observations remain dated to their original read.

controls.label: USDU Solana mint authority
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 452346328, an atomic getMultipleAccounts read returned the exact USDu mint with self-referential mintAuthority, no freezeAuthority, 6 decimals, and metadataPointer/tokenMetadata extensions. The issuer-listed USDu Program USDuuELLS5piwJ7vmMoKByqxaguyZov7CxKQHYRBvo5 is executable and upgradeable: ProgramData CdPKgzLeuqFXaa16jchGUmK9ZaVqq8j6GfYwVLH5q9PX records upgrade authority 3UWMx8oCchy53x48aSb25SeSobqLfqF8U6eiCyUSdeVB. The issuer-listed USDu Config is owned by that program. This identifies the deployed program and its upgrade key; it does not prove the mint's signer derivation or current program-to-mint authorization. The two published Solana audits reference historical commits, and their source repository currently returns 404. Signer custody and audited-source equivalence to the deployed program remain unresolved.

controls.label: UnitasMintingV2 (BSC token-authorized minter)
controls.capDescription: Verified mint() requires MINTER_ROLE, a signed and deduplicated order, a valid route, a collateral-asset per-block limit, and a global per-block limit. These are rate limits, not a fixed outstanding-liability ceiling; the contract admin can alter them.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 125056986, USDu.minter() returned this address. At block 125057055, owner() returned 0x0a6db8e8f0b79ba5b9f5ac7f5728843b830bb1c8 and globalConfig() returned nonzero global mint/redeem limits. Sourcify's verified UnitasMintingV2 source directly records MINTER_ROLE, order-signature, route and per-block checks.

controls.label: UnitasMintingV2 admin — Safe 3-of-5
controls.evidence: At BSC block 125057055, UnitasMintingV2.owner() returned this address. A fresh pinned read at block 125059057 identified Safe 1.4.1, the five recorded signers, threshold 3, no enabled modules, a zero guard slot, the recorded master copy and a nonzero fallback handler. Verified SingleAdminAccessControl and UnitasMintingV2 source give this admin role-setting and rate-limit powers; operational signer-key custody and any off-chain delay are not established.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-01. Pinned BSC reads and verified token source correct the earlier onlyOwner mint claim: the owner Safe selects a separate UnitasMintingV2 minter, which has an independently addressed admin. Its order/role/rate-limit checks are explicit, but rate limits are not an outstanding-supply ceiling. Solana's mint authority remains non-null; the prior assertion that a self-referential, non-executable account cannot sign is withdrawn because Token-2022 validates signer authorization without that restriction. Existing periodic reconciliation and attestation-only supervision are retained; the refreshed Accountable API and September HT Digital collateral letter do not establish prudential supervision.

scopedQuestions.question: Does the issuer-listed upgradeable USDu Program control the mint through a PDA signer, and what current source/binary verification and authority account establish that path? At finalized slot 452346328 its upgrade authority is 3UWMx8oCchy53x48aSb25SeSobqLfqF8U6eiCyUSdeVB; operator identity and key custody remain unverified.
What operational signer-key custody and off-chain authorization safeguards govern the current 3-of-5 UnitasMintingV2 admin Safe?
